Live: Storm Edda reaches the coast

Follow the latest as the storm crosses the bay.

Share Email

11:05

The harbour master has closed the outer moorings until the evening tide, and the ferry to Skerrin will not sail again today. Passengers with tickets can travel tomorrow, or ask for a refund at the terminal.

Waves of four metres were measured off the breakwater, the highest this year.

10:20

Power is out in about 1,200 homes in the north of the town, according to the grid operator, which says crews are waiting for the wind to drop before they climb the poles.

09:40

Good morning, and welcome to our live coverage. The storm made landfall just after nine, bringing gusts of up to 110 km/h, heavy rain, and a high tide that has already flooded the promenade.
